steps.label: Known PFAS-related health effects
steps.text:
• Developmental Problems in Children
• Increased Risk of Cancer
• Weakens Effectiveness of Immune System
• Interference with Natural Hormones
• Increased Cholesterol

steps.label: Why Not Just Remove Them?
steps.text: PFAS are often too small to filter away. They also contain Carbon-Fluorine bonds which are too strong to break, giving them the nickname 'Forever Chemicals'.

steps.label: We can filter through sugaring to find PFAS concentrations!
steps.text: More info! We can learn about nature and ourselves through this project.
